CustomField.description: Calculates the agent’s overall risk score based on data sensitivity, client impact, business criticality, connector exposure and the breadth of team sharing.
CustomField.formula: /* SHARING EXPOSURE */ + IF( INCLUDES(Team__c, "All"), 2, MIN( 2, MAX( 0, ( IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "DBS"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "DCO"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "DCR"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Digital_Marketing"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Direction"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Equity"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Fixed_Income"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Investment Solutions"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Marketing"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "ProductSpecialists"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Product Strategy"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "RFP"), 1, 0) + IF(INCLUDES(Team__c, "Sales"), 1, 0) ) - 1 ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated from the agent’s risk factors. A higher score indicates a higher overall level of exposure and business impact.
CustomField.label: Overall Risk Score
